28K likes, 208 comments - s8ul.esports on September 20, 2026: "Not every journey ends with a trophy.
Some journeys build the team that eventually lifts one. 

EWC Paris 2026 was everything the pressure, the celebrations, the setbacks, the comebacks, and every moment we fought to make it count.

But this isn’t where the story ends.

We take the lessons. We carry the memories. We turn the setbacks into fuel.

We’ll be back. Stronger than before. Hungrier than ever. 🚀💙

#GameShuru #EWC2026 #CampaEnergy #YouTubeIndia #AMD".
